triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER complete_application_documents AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.application_documents DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.check_complete_application()
CREATE TRIGGER documents_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.application_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.prevent_evidence_update()
CREATE TRIGGER events_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.application_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.prevent_event_change()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER complete_application_sponsors AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.application_sponsors DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.check_complete_application()
CREATE TRIGGER sponsors_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.application_sponsors FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.prevent_evidence_update()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER complete_application AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON cchia_admissions.applications DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_admissions.check_complete_application()

CREATE TRIGGER check_invitation_scope BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF role_code, scope_id ON cchia_m02.role_invitations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cchia_m02.check_role_scope_kind()

constraints.definition: CHECK (kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['vigencia'::character varying, 'personeria'::character varying, 'estatutos'::character varying, 'antecedentes'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (legal::text = 'natural'::text AND natural_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(natural_name::text) <> ''::text AND natural_identifier IS NOT NULL AND btrim(natural_identifier::text) <> ''::text AND organization_name IS NULL AND organization_identifier IS NULL AND representative_name IS NULL AND representative_identifier IS NULL OR legal::text = 'juridica'::text AND organization_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(organization_name::text) <> ''::text AND organization_identifier IS NOT NULL AND btrim(organization_identifier::text) <> ''::text AND representative_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(representative_name::text) <> ''::text AND representative_identifier IS NOT NULL AND btrim(representative_identifier::text) <> ''::text AND natural_name IS NULL AND natural_identifier IS NULL)

CHECK ((status::text = ANY (ARRAY['received'::character varying, 'under_review'::character varying]::text[])) AND decision_at IS NULL AND decision_by_user_id IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NULL OR (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying]::text[])) AND decision_at IS NOT NULL AND decision_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(decision_reason) <> ''::text AND decision_at >= submitted_at)
CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['received'::character varying, 'under_review'::character varying, 'approved'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying]::text[]))

CHECK (kind = 'global'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'organization'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NOT NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'commission'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NOT NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'mesa'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NOT NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'agreement'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NOT NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'resource'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NOT NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NULL OR kind = 'electoral_process'::cchia_m02.scope_kind AND company_id IS NULL AND commission_id IS NULL AND mesa_id IS NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL AND resource_id IS NULL AND electoral_process_id IS NOT NULL)
